title: Recipe book and shopping list
goal: Build a recipe book web app with a shopping list. To write a recipe there is a text input with the placeholder "Recipe name", a text input with the placeholder "Ingredient", a text input with the placeholder "Quantity" (a whole number) and a button labelled "Add ingredient", which adds the ingredient to the recipe being written, shown as "QUANTITY x INGREDIENT", and clears the ingredient and quantity inputs. A button labelled "Save recipe" stores the recipe with its ingredients and clears the form. Saved recipes are listed as "NAME (K ingredients)", each with a button labelled "Plan NAME" that adds the recipe's ingredients to the shopping list on the server: an ingredient already on the list gets the quantities added together, a new one goes to the end. The section headed "Shopping list" shows each item as "INGREDIENT: QUANTITY", or "List is empty", and a button labelled "Clear list" removes every item. The server stores the recipes with their ingredients, and the shopping list. Stored recipes and the shopping list are shown when the page loads and kept when the server restarts.
